units: <cite ref="Yoma 10a:13">Yoma 10ᵃ</cite> <he>בית ד׳</he> a compartment in the Temple designated for a dwelling.
<cite ref="Yoma 10b:5">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>דִּירַת קבע</he> permanent residence, opp. <he>ד׳ עראי</he>.
Ib. ד׳ בעל כרחה וכ׳ a dwelling not freely chosen (as the High-priests’ in the Temple) is not called a dwelling (to require M’zuzah).
<cite ref="Yoma 11b:1">Ib. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>מיוחד לד׳</he>, v. <cite ref="J00268"><he>יָחַד</he></cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דִּירוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite>; v., however, <cite ref="D00727"><he>דִּיר</he></cite>.
